text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series!
The Umamusume world is 
in a true Warring States era!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"A dazzling clash of rivals, a battle of 
warlords! Competing for supremacy, crying 
'I am the greatest under heaven!'~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Countless warlords will likely stand in 
our way. However—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I must strike them down and pull off an 
upset over them all—!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's aim for the top under ...
Yeah, let's aim to be the best und...

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I train is— the Sengoku 
Umamusume, No Reason.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's aim to be the best in ...
Yeah, let's aim to be the greatest...

text_block_list.text:
Though still unknown, like a Sengoku 
warlord staging an uprising against their 
master, she plotted to unify the realm 
under her rule.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Trainer. First, let me 
tell you about the faction that will 
surely be our greatest foe.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: That greatest power was none other than—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The Clan of Silence!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, from Lady Special Week, Supreme 
Commander of Japan, to Lady Silence 
Suzuka, Demon of the Front. 'Tis a clan 
blessed with many formidable Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"That household has been sweeping 
countless GIs in an unstoppable, 
triumphant march! If left unchecked, 
before long—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The realm shall undoubtedly belong to 
them!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The "Silent Clan" is our greatest enemy
of 
all!

Hearing it out of nowhere like that, 
though...

No Reason lumps a certain group of 
Umamusume together and calls them that on 
her own, but...
choice_data_list: Does a family like that really exi...
Does a family like that really exi...

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume whose names came up had far 
too little in common.
It wasn't as if they 
were all meek, either...

Even their preferred running styles were 
completely varied, ranging from Front 
Runner to Chaser.
choice_data_list: There's no proof we're actually re...
There's no proof we're actually re...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Basis, you say? I do have a basis. And 
that is—
choice_data_list: There's no proof they're part of t...
There's no proof they're part of t...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's this ancient manuscript, yeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This is a secret tome kept quietly in a 
corner of the library.
According to what's 
written here...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Their supple bodies, their sheer 
willpower—the common thread between them 
is undeniable. And—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Wielding those as their weapons,
everyone 
has achieved sweeping victories on the 
grand stage.
We can't help but see them as our kin."

It seems it wasn't entirely groundless. 
Though the credibility of ancient texts
is 
questionable...

If the essence of their running truly is 
similar, we can't just dismiss it as pure 
nonsense.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, did you believe it?! And so,
the 
Clan of Silence is truly taking the realm 
by storm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Their supple running style poses quite a 
threat. A straightforward approach might 
not suffice against them. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I have the ambition to win, by whatever 
means necessary!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Are you willing to stick with me through 
thick and thin, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah! Of course, I'll follow you!
Yeah! Of course I'll come along!

text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume acting like a Sengoku 
warlord. No Reason is certainly a bit 
eccentric, but...
choice_data_list: Yeah! Of course, I'll follow you!
Yeah! Of course I'll follow you!

text_block_list.text:
Her caliber is the real deal. She's 
ambitious—and a master strategist.

He's a trickster through and through—even 
willing to deceive his opponents to
snatch 
an unexpected victory.

I was utterly captivated by such bold and 
carefree grandeur.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then let us aim for supremacy 
together. However, should you fail me 
terribly...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. How about we have them do the 
Horya-Horya dance for us!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ah, heave-ho! Ah, heave-ho!

No Reason dances cheerfully. Yet behind 
her eyes... she isn't really laughing.

I get the feeling their true motive lies 
elsewhere. If this goes south...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: MmhââWhy do you think so?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Na-hahaha! Don't say such dangerous 
things!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well—I won't say it's impossible, mind 
you.

For just a fraction of a second, the 
corners of her eyes sharpen. Somehow... I 
can tell.

No Reason is a decisive Umamusume. If she 
thinks something isn't doing any good for 
either of them, she'll probably cut ties 
cleanly.

That cold, pragmatic ruthlessness was 
another part of No Reason's charm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on, don't be so hasty. 
Challenging the Shogunate that rules the 
land right off the bat won't end well.
choice_data_list: Then first up... toppling the Sile...
Then first up... toppling the Sile...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The immediate enemy is, see,
that one over 
there, that one.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh... The die is cast.
Let us 
advance toward that far-off utopia.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The time to set sail has come! When I 
reach the other side, the humble 'ore' 
will evolve into the grand 'watashi'! 
Bwahahaha!!

"Tanino Gimlet. The frontrunner of our 
generation, and a god of destruction with 
a truly unique tongue..."

"Her reputation was already high, and her 
future potential was deemed more than 
promising."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
She is not of the Clan of Silence. Yet 
she, too, is an Umamusume who may yet 
claim dominion over all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to fall behind. Defeating 
him is the first step in overthrowing the 
top!

And so, No Reason and my Sengoku picture 
scroll began, aiming for our own grand 
uprising.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The time is the Warring States period! 
Right now, a nameless, run-of-the-mill 
Umamusume, No Reason. But—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I shall show the world my way of life,
and 
leave my running etched in history!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: To battleeeeeee!!
